scene: Pushing through the brass turnstile, you emerge onto the Grand Concourse depot.
picture: A flat side-scrolling transit concourse. Far left, a vintage green streetcar stands ready on tracks. Left, the grandfather pushes his plant-laden bicycle through the open turnstile. Centre, an orange koi-shaped passenger boat floats at a low water dock. Right, a glass-domed garden tram rests on elevated track rails with doors open.
shown: a vintage green streetcar waiting on tracks at the far left
an orange koi-shaped boat moored at the canal dock in the centre
a glass-topped tram adorned with vines waiting on rails at the right
